mode: read-only catalog; no fiscal rows read or changed

indexes.name: idx_fiscal_active_product_sale_os
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_fiscal_active_product_sale_os ON public.fiscal_invoices USING btree (organization_id, work_order_id, environment) WHERE ((direction = 'output'::text) AND (work_order_id IS NOT NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'pending'::text, 'processing'::text, 'authorized'::text])))

triggers.name: trg_prevent_duplicate_active_fiscal_invoice_per_os
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_prevent_duplicate_active_fiscal_invoice_per_os BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF organization_id, work_order_id, tipo_documento, environment, direction, status, payload_json ON public.fiscal_invoices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_duplicate_active_fiscal_invoice_per_os()
